Company in which directors are substantially interested
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:OriginalObject: The Company as a part of its financial strategy proposes to offer, issue and allot Convertible Warrants to its Promoter/Non Promoter/Promoter group member on preferential basis, for infusing additional funds in the Company which may be employed in the business of the Company and/or may be used to augment the funding needs for re-structuring/settlement of liabilities/debts and/or such other appropriate arrangements and/or understanding with Bankers and/or other Creditors and/or investment in technology and/or for general corporate purposes which shall enhance the business of the Company and for any other purpose as may be decided and approved by the Board.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureNotesOnObjectsForWhi:
Pursuant to the allotment of 25,20,000 equity shares upon conversion of warrants made on August 6, 2026, the Company received an amount of Rs.1,205.82 Lakhs. The entire amount received has been fully utilised for the stated objects.

50,00,000 Convertible Warrants were allotted on 23.05.2025 at Rs.63.80 per warrant (aggregating Rs.3,190.00 Lakhs). 25% (Rs.797.50 Lakhs) was received on allotment and utilised for the stated objects, as reported in the statement for the year ended 31.03.2026.

During the quarter ended 30.09.2026, 35,20,000 warrants were converted into equity shares and the balance 75% consideration of Rs.1,684.32 Lakhs was received on conversion.

Unutilised proceeds of Rs.400.00 Lakhs as on 30.09.2026 are lying in Company’s bank account pending utilisation for the stated objects.
